verdict.rationale: Modal's pricing page documents a Workspace budget for limiting monthly spend, which directly covers the spend-limit half of the story. It also says a timeout length is configurable, and the platform scales to zero, which supports automatic shutdown of idle capacity. missing for 10: detail on how budgets are enforced (hard stop vs. alert), explicit documentation of what the configurable timeout governs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can set auto-shutdown timers or spend limits so a forgotten instance can't silently run up a huge bill

citations.quote: If you want to limit your monthly spend, you can [set a Workspace budget](/docs/guide/budgets#workspace-budgets).
However, this timeout length is configurable.
Turn any function into an HTTPS endpoint that scales with traffic and idles at zero.
